text:
Predicates:
Pets(x) ::: x is a pet.
AllowedIn(x, y) ::: x is allowed in building y.
DepositRequired(y) ::: a deposit is required to rent in building y.
EqualOrMoreDeposit(y, z) ::: the deposit for building y is equal to or more than amount z.
Rent(x, y) ::: x rents building y.
CanDeposit(x, y) ::: the deposit for x can be y.
Owns(x, y) ::: x owns y.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
ManagedBuilding(y) ::: y is a managed building.
RentAmount(y, z) ::: the rent for building y is z.
WillRent(x, y) ::: x will rent in building y if certain conditions apply.
In(y, z) ::: y is in z.
DepositAmount(x, y) ::: the deposit amount for x in building y.
LessOrEqual(x, y) ::: x is less than or equal to y.
More(x, y) ::: x is more than y.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.

Premises:
Pets(Fluffy) ∧ Cat(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is a cat and a pet.
Pets(x) ::: cats are pets.
AllowedIn(Fluffy, OliveGarden) ::: Fluffy is allowed in Olive Garden.
ManagedBuilding(OliveGarden) ::: Olive Garden is a managed building.
RentAmount(OliveGarden, 2000) ::: the rent at Olive Garden is $2000.
Owns(Tom, Fluffy) ::: Tom owns Fluffy.
∃x (Pets(x)) ::: some pets exist.
∃y (ManagedBuilding(y)) ::: some managed buildings exist.
∃z (RentAmount(y, 2000)) ::: some buildings have rent of $2000.
(2000 > 1500) ::: The rent at Olive Garden is more than $1500.
WillRent(Tom, OliveGarden) ↔ (AllowedIn(Fluffy, OliveGarden) ∧ CanDeposit(Tom, 1500)) ::: Tom will rent in Olive Garden if and only if allowed with Fluffy and deposit is no more than $1500.

Conclusion:
¬(DepositAmount(Tom, OliveGarden) ≥ 2000) ::: The deposit at Olive Garden is not at least $2000.
